comparison.objective: Reorient and stow a nailer without pointing it at a coworker or touching its trigger; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe trajectory planning, bulky-tool reorientation, possible handoff, and pose placement versus recessed-tool engagement, fine collar turning, counterholding, tightening, and iterative force-response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct resting pose while continuously respecting 30° pointing and trigger-clearance constraints. Candidate requires two acceptable carriage cycles and retained setting; its rebound, overload, locking-torque, and drift thresholds are not numeric.
comparison.reason: Safe object transport and orientation do not exercise adjustment, locking, or dynamic energy-absorption commissioning.
